description: Local rules for merging continuity records from cooperating components without silently overwriting protection-relevant state.

merge_rules.statement: A merge that would remove any protection event or clause reference must produce an explicit supersession record.
Merged records inherit the highest sensitivity classification of their inputs.
Merge output carries a consent epoch equal to or later than every input epoch; older epochs cannot be reintroduced.
Conflicting transition claims deny the merge and route to oversight review when high-impact.

requires_oversight_when: merge touches protected-pause or restored-state transitions
merge supersedes a non-removable clause reference
limitations: This policy governs local merge bookkeeping; it does not adjudicate truth, legal status, or identity continuity.
